title: Alkoholisierter Mann nach wiederholten Straftaten im Unterbindungsgewahrsam

extraction.summaryEn: A 41-year-old man was taken into custody after repeated offences in Tempelhof, including insulting and spitting at a woman, resisting arrest and an antisemitic remark, investigated by the state security unit. He had about 2.5 and later about 2 per mille blood alcohol after an e-bike fall.
